text:
Liam (AM): kicking off onboarding for HelioRetail — thanks everyone for joining. goal: go-live with Redwood Hosted API + basic reranking by 30d. can we surface stakeholders and any immediate risks?
Maya (CSM): assigning primary contacts: 
- Exec sponsor: Tara (Helio)
- Engineering lead: Raj
- Data ops: Priya
Will loop in onboarding calendar in a sec. :calendar: 
Devon (Solutions Eng): dev contact + expected integration surface pls — are they using server-side only or client SDK? also need env access for test dataset.
Liam (AM): Raj confirmed server-side integration; will grant a sandbox S3 with sample logs.
Olivia (Product): success criteria suggestion:
- Acceptance: 95% of priority prompts match quality baseline in evals
- Perf: P95 token latency < 350ms for 512-token sequences
- Cost: avg cost/token under agreed threshold (will share numbers)
- Security: data path reviewed by Helio security and our POAM documented
Maya (CSM): capture onboarding milestones: 0-7d: env access + smoke run; 8-21d: feature integration + evals; 22-30d: rollout + acceptance signoff.
Devon (Solutions Eng): noted. immediate blockers: 1) Helio needs a signed DPA before we can process PII test data 2) their infra team needs our allowlist for egress IPs.
OnboardBot: New kickoff doc created: https://docs.redwood.com/kickoffs/helio-321 — contains checklist and calendar invite.
Maya (CSM): adding risks: renewal risk flagged if exec sponsor drops off — recommend biweekly sponsor sync and an exec intro deck.
Liam (AM): agree. can someone own sponsor cadence? Maya you ok?
Maya (CSM): I can own sponsor cadence. will do first intro next Tue. :thumbsup:
Devon (Solutions Eng): technical owner action items (I'll take these):
```
- request sandbox credentials from Helio (due 3210000140)
- provide sample integration snippet and schema (due 3210000155)
- run smoke test and post results to kickoff doc
```
Olivia (Product): I'll prepare the acceptance test rubric and a short eval prompt set. will share by EOD Friday.
Liam (AM): timeline confirmed: target go-live 30 days from today (target date: 3210000123 + 30d). if any blocker shifts timeline call it out here.
Maya (CSM): logging meeting notes and next steps in the doc. quick ask: who will own post-go-live health dashboard?
Devon (Solutions Eng): ops handover: I'll hand dashboard to Helio ops and our SRE contact after we validate metrics.
Liam (AM): perfect. final quick items:
- Need DPA signed (legal) — Liam will chase.
- IP allowlist — Helio infra to provide list by EOD tomorrow.
- Sandbox dataset ready — Priya to confirm.
Maya (CSM): added to doc and set reminders. thanks team.
OnboardBot: Reminder set: Sponsor intro (Maya) scheduled for Tue 10:00am.
Devon (Solutions Eng): posting quick integration snippet so Raj can start: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <SANDBOX_KEY>" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-small", "input":"summarize: order 12345"}'
```
Maya (CSM): Raj looped in; he says Priya will confirm dataset by 3210000168. I'll update doc. :white_check_mark:
Liam (AM): great progress. keep updates in the doc thread, put urgent blockers here. thanks everyone!
